risk_fusion_architecture.role_of_satellite_evidence: Contextual environmental evidence. Modifies surface susceptibility friction, strictly distinct from primary meteorological triggers.
risk_fusion_architecture.ml_isolation_guarantee: Neither XGBoost model (Susceptibility or Trigger) was modified, retrained, or altered. Feature vectors, ordering, and evaluation remain 100% intact.
risk_fusion_architecture.bounded_contribution_range: [-3, +5] integer points added to the baseline/ML fused score before final clamping to [0, 100].

bare.interpretation: Exposed bare soil, loose scree, or barren rock surfaces lack root anchoring and vegetation canopy, increasing vulnerability to surface slumping and rainfall-induced detachment (+5 pts).

vegetation.interpretation: Dense tree canopy and root networks provide rainfall interception and mechanical topsoil shear reinforcement, offering contextual stabilization (-3 pts). Does not eliminate hazard under extreme precipitation.

cropland.interpretation: Cultivated/agricultural fields represent managed loose soil and modified slope drainage, contributing moderate contextual susceptibility (+2 pts).

built_up.interpretation: Artificial structures, pavements, and road cuttings increase surface runoff and represent exposed infrastructure assets (+1 pt).

water.interpretation: Permanent water bodies represent aquatic environments; neutral contribution (0 pts).

other.interpretation: Alpine snow/ice or unclassified terrain; neutral contribution (0 pts).

unknown.interpretation: Cloud-covered, unresolvable, or unclassified pixels; neutral contribution (0 pts).

unavailable_data_and_failure_behavior.zero_substitution_prohibition: Missing or failed satellite data is NEVER converted into a safe vegetation category or zero. It is strictly classified as available: false and category: 'unknown'.
unavailable_data_and_failure_behavior.score_neutrality: When satellite data is unavailable, timed out, rate-limited, or errored, contributionPoints is strictly 0. The risk score exactly equals the baseline/ML fused score without fluctuation.
unavailable_data_and_failure_behavior.metadata_transparency: The response explicitly exposes satelliteEvidence: { available: false, category: 'unknown', contributionPoints: 0, interpretation: '...' } so users and authorities have complete provenance clarity.

early_warning_safety_behavior.non_escalation_guarantee: Satellite evidence alone can NEVER trigger a WATCH, WARNING, or CRITICAL alert. It enters earlyWarningService as contextual evidence (level: 'context') and does not increment primary escalation points.
early_warning_safety_behavior.primary_triggers_responsible: Only high rainfall, saturated soil moisture, steep slope topography, verified field reports, or high ML trigger probabilities can escalate warning levels.

satelliteEvidence.source: string (e.g. Sentinel-2 10m Land Cover (ESA / Impact Observatory))
satelliteEvidence.category: vegetation | bare | cropland | built_up | water | other | unknown

limitations: Satellite land-cover evidence represents annual composite surface classification and does not track micro-hourly vegetation defoliation or rapid debris clearing.
Bounded contribution is calibrated conservatively to prevent undue influence on life-safety operational decisions.
Optical cloud cover over Himalayan mountain summits will return 'unknown', safely falling back to zero contribution.
